name: M3_MMS200MI_UpdItmBasic
description: Update basic item master data for an existing item in the item master. This operation maintains most core attributes shown in Item Open (MMS001), panels E/F/G/M: status and descriptions, responsibility, basic and alternate units of measure, item and product groups, business area, item category, make/buy and inventory accounting settings, weights and volume, quality and inspection settings, tax and VAT codes, hierarchy levels, search groups, and several user-defined and technical attributes. It only changes existing items; creation of new items is handled by separate add operations.

inputParameters.description: Item number identifying the item whose basic master data will be updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the item master record is updated.

inputParameters.name: STAT
inputParameters.description: New status to assign to the item, such as preliminary, definite, or blocked.

inputParameters.name: ITDS
